name: Gnoarn
summary: In Ironforge, Gnoarn helps his scattered people find aid. The exiled gnome lives in Tinker Town after the fall of Gnomeregan, directing travelers to fellow engineers and survivors.

sections.title: A Displaced Citizen of Gnomeregan
sections.body: Gnoarn keeps track of Gnomeregan's scattered survivors from Tinker Town in Ironforge. Troggs invaded the great underground city, and catastrophic radiation made it uninhabitable. The Bronzebeard dwarves gave Gnoarn refuge, as they did many of his people. He now points capable travelers toward gnomes who need help abroad, including the stranded pilot Bingles Blastenheimer in Loch Modan and the ambitious engineer Shoni the Shilent in Stormwind.

faq.answer: Gnoarn is a gnomish survivor who lives among the refugees in Tinker Town, Ironforge's gnomish quarter. He directs travelers to aid exiled gnomes working across Alliance lands.
Gnoarn can be found in Tinker Town, in northeastern Ironforge, among the machinery and workbenches of his exiled kin.

faq.q: What tasks does Gnoarn give out?
faq.answer: Gnoarn directs travelers to help scattered gnomes. He sends them to Loch Modan to check on the missing pilot Bingles Blastenheimer, or to Stormwind to speak with the inventor Shoni the Shilent about her gyrodrillmatic excavationators.
Before Gnomeregan fell, Gnoarn was known for his eccentric 'gnomefro' hairstyle. He lost it in the catastrophic fallout and radioactive venting that devastated his home city.

angles.text: As a gnome, you can see Gnoarn's resolve in how he keeps displaced engineers in touch across the Eastern Kingdoms.
As an Alliance hero passing through Ironforge, you can speak with Gnoarn for leads on gnomish engineering efforts in Dun Morogh, Loch Modan, and Stormwind.
